notes: Three demonstrative phrases (that city, those days, that city again) put the written determiner on the demonstrative pronoun and leave the articles unrepresented (rules 41, 47).

Flagged unit אֲשֶׁר … מִשָּׁם → from whence retained as one resumptive rendering headed on the relative: read as one rendering rather than one token under rule 30, since dropping from leaves no morpheme short of its own English while dropping whence loses the relative. The competing split — from to מִן, whence to the relative, שָׁם unrepresented — is named in that unit's note.
In the death of the high priest the rectum is arthrous, so the noun's article takes the written the and the adjective's agreement article is unrepresented (rules 29, 47).
